(rule!
  (for*/fold ([out g])
             ([r (in-range (rows g))]
              [c (in-range (- (cols g) 2))])
    (if (and (= (at g r c) 2) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 3) (= (at g r (+ c 2)) 0))
        (set-cell out r (+ c 2) 8)
        out)))

(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
             (marked ((lambda (g) (for*/fold ([out g])
             ([r (in-range (rows g))]
              [c (in-range (- (cols g) 2))])
    (if (and (= (at g r c) 2) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 3) (= (at g r (+ c 2)) 0))
        (set-cell out r (+ c 2) 8)
        out))) g))
             (boundary? (lambda (o) (or (= (obj-r1 o) 0) (= (obj-c1 o) 0) (= (obj-r2 o) (- h 1)) (= (obj-c2 o) (- w 1)))))
             (zeros (lambda (grid) (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 0)) (objects grid -1))))
             (old (zeros g))
             (old-open (apply append (map obj-cells (filter boundary? old))))
             (now (zeros marked))
             (eligible (filter (lambda (o) (and (not (boundary? o)) (member (first (obj-cells o)) old-open))) now)))
        (reduce (lambda (out o) (paint-cells out (obj-cells o) 4)) marked eligible))))
